tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and till background: chalk by day, near-black midnight in dark mode.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Product tiles, cards, the cart panel and sheets.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells behind grouped controls, the receipt backdrop, empty states.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers and resting tile borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders that must hold 3:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and prices, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, units and metadata, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: midnight
tokens.usage: The brand's dark: the logo, the app icon ground, the checkout total bar and marketing panels. The same in both themes.

tokens.name: on-midnight
tokens.usage: Text on midnight.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Volt lime, the waiting dot: the Pay button, the cart count, the unsynced dot, highlights. A fill only; never text on light surfaces.

tokens.name: on-lime
tokens.usage: Text on a lime fill (the Pay button label). Always midnight.

tokens.name: lime-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fills behind lime-ink text: sale complete, synced, offers.

tokens.name: lime-ink
tokens.usage: Lime as text and icons, on surface, surface-raised and lime-soft.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and the selected tile border: midnight by day, chalk at night.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on a primary fill.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Signal blue: links, the selected payment chip, info. As text, on surface, surface-raised and blue-soft.

tokens.name: blue-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows and chips, info notices.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Sale complete, synced, in stock: an alias of lime-ink, on the surfaces and lime-soft. Always with a word or check.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the sale-complete banner and synced badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Offline, low stock, waiting to sync. As text, on the surfaces and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of offline and low-stock notices.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Alert coral as a fill: badges and the void button's icon. Not for text on light surfaces.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Voids, refunds, errors and overdue credit. As text, on the surfaces and danger-soft. Always with a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error notices and the void confirmation.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links: an alias of blue.

tokens.name: receipt-paper
tokens.usage: Thermal receipt previews stay paper-white in both themes.

tokens.name: receipt-ink
tokens.usage: Text on receipt-paper; thermal printers print one ink.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Figtree at its heaviest, tight. The logo's wordmark is drawn separately and is never typed.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Marketing headlines and the landing page hero.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles in the app and back office.

styles.name: total
styles.usage: The checkout total and the day's takings: the biggest number on screen.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Figtree: open, friendly, very legible at arm's length on a cheap tablet.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section and category headings, sheet titles.

styles.name: tile
styles.usage: Product names on quick-tap tiles and cart lines.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices on tiles and cart lines; use tabular figures.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Add toppings or tap Pay to finish the sale.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small uppercase labels, badges and table headers.

groups.name: Receipt
groups.note: JetBrains Mono: thermal receipts and anything that must line up in columns.

styles.name: receipt
styles.usage: Receipt lines, reference numbers, MoMo transaction IDs.

styles.name: receipt-strong
styles.usage: The receipt total and shop name.

spacing.note: 4px base. POS screens use the larger steps: fingers, not cursors.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside badges and chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between tiles in the quick-tap grid; between related rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tile and card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections; screen gutters on tablets.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large separations on marketing pages.

radius.note: Round, like the mark: soft rectangles, and true circles for anything that is a dot.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and product tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, cards, the app icon.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Payment chips, pills and dots.

size.note: Touch sizes for tablets and phones used standing at a counter.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: The smallest thing a finger may hit.

tokens.name: tap-pos
tokens.usage: Height of POS buttons and payment chips.

tokens.name: tile-min
tokens.usage: Minimum width and height of a quick-tap product tile.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: The waiting dot as a UI signal: unsynced sales, new orders, unread.

shadow.note: Mostly flat. One lift for tiles, one for floating sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Product tiles and cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, the payment dialog, toasts.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard and scanner focus: a 2px page-colour gap, then 2px of solid blue.
